notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Light, legible calculator with live region, keyboard, 12-digit cap and a clear friendly divide-by-zero message; C and CE side by side is slightly redundant.
notes.b1/j1/C-r1: Clean dark calculator with a wide zero, big readable display, caps at 12 digits, aria-live and keyboard support; the Error message is terse but fine.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Familiar iOS-style layout that is compact and correct, but the display is small, AC/C label flips and the percent key goes slightly beyond basic.
notes.b1/j1/C-r2: Charming segment-LCD skeuomorph, but limited to 9 digits, heavy rendering code and decorative extras overbuild a basic calculator.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Small, tidy code and correct maths, but almost no aria, a tiny divide-by-zero message and a low-contrast operator colour.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Most polished retro LCD with printed keyboard hints and good accessibility, but it is the largest source and clearly overbuilt for a basic calculator.
notes.b1/j2/C-r2: Charming pocket-calculator look with an LCD, clear key hierarchy and good a11y, though the 9-digit cap and the faint ERR label are small quirks.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Clean iOS-style dark calculator with a history line, correct arithmetic and keyboard support, but little ARIA and a generic look.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD and keys with CE and shortcut hints, but it is the largest file and goes past basic.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Plain, correct dark calculator with a bare Error message and a left-aligned 0 label, so it looks the least finished.
notes.b1/j2/C-r1: Tidy dark theme with a blue accent, expression line, backspace and a red Error, correct and cohesive.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Light, legible, well-spaced layout with C, CE and backspace, an expression line and a clear divide-by-zero message that fits the display.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Clean iOS-style dark calculator with history line and clear divide-by-zero message, but few aria hooks and the % key is extra.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD with Error state, but it is overbuilt (branding, indicators, shortcut footer, CE plus backspace) and the long source pads a basic calculator.
notes.b1/j3/C-r2: Compact retro pocket calculator with seven-segment display, wide equals and good semantics; a bit decorative, truncates to 8 digits.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Light, high-contrast and legible with a red divide-by-zero message, thousands grouping, auto-shrinking display, solid aria and keyboard support.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Solid dark layout with strong orange operators and Error state, but the long 20-nine display is tiny and 0 label is left-aligned oddly.
notes.b1/j3/C-r1: Minimal dark theme with a restrained blue accent, history line, Error in red, 12-digit cap, good roles and keyboard handling.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Striking retro LCD calculator with solid logic and keyboard/aria support, but at 18KB it is heavier than basic and the faint ghost segments plus tiny hint text cost some clarity.
notes.b2/j1/C-r3: Warm, clean and legible with an expression line, a clear divide-by-zero message, comma grouping and good aria and keyboard support, all in a moderate amount of code.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Compact iOS-style dark calculator that gets the arithmetic right, but it has minimal accessibility, a low-contrast operator column and a plain, cramped look.
notes.b2/j1/C-r4: Clean light design with a clear error state, an expression line and good aria support, though the pale operator keys are subtle.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Generic iOS clone that works, but it has almost no aria, a bare Error with no explanation, a dead-code branch and every operator key in the same orange.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Polished dark glass look with a full-width equals key and good aria and keyboard support, though the decorative glow and the hint line pad it slightly past basic.
notes.b2/j2/C-r4: Calm, clear light design with AC/C toggle, active-operator highlight, shrinking digits, aria-live and full keyboard; correct on all cases, code a bit tangled.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Standard iOS-style dark calculator with commas and correct results, but sparse aria labels (symbol-only buttons) and a plain, generic look.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Polished dark glass look with labelled buttons, C/CE/backspace and a keyboard hint; a little extra chrome and longer source.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Leanest and most basic, correct, but flat styling, no backspace key on screen, minimal aria labels, and a dead AC ternary.
notes.b2/j2/C-r3: Warm, legible light theme with strong display contrast, C/CE/backspace, helpful error caption, good aria labels and phone fit, in tidy code.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Gorgeous seven-segment retro calculator and arithmetic is sound with repeat-equals, but it is overbuilt for 'basic' and the large SVG-drawing source is heavy.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clean iOS-like dark calculator with correct chaining and error handling, but few aria labels and a generic look.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Polished dark UI with good aria and keyboard, but extra CE/backspace/%, glow backdrop and tiny hint text pad it past basic.
notes.b2/j3/C-r4: Warm light theme with clear hierarchy, helpful 'Cannot divide by zero' note, good aria and a lean source.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD calculator with strong craft but overbuilt, large source and a segment display that is harder to read.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Smallest and most basic dark calculator, correct, though the divide-by-zero message replaces the display in plain text and aria is minimal.
notes.b2/j3/C-r3: Warm, high-contrast design with dark display, tinted operators and clear Error feedback, good aria and keyboard support.
